The nine refusal fixtures cover the ordinary enclosing shape, unnamed declaration, named/mode-bearing/missing-match child, conflicting default, external applicable rule and duplicate enclosure. They do not certify unused nested bodies or package override behavior. No compiler/runtime changes or gate promotions are included.
sections.13:
Complete synthetic [batch input](../examples/enclosing-modes/input.xml):

```xml
<batch><invoice id="INV-2048" currency="EUR"><line sku="P100"/><line sku="P200"/></invoice><invoice id="INV-2049" currency="USD"><line sku="P300"/></invoice></batch>
```

Complete [refused 4.0 stylesheet](../examples/enclosing-modes/main-refusal4.xsl):

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
AUTHOR: Charles Korthout
CREATE DATE: 12 October 2026
PURPOSE: Verify deferred enclosing modes and portable invoice export/audit dispatch.
SPECIAL NOTES: Named top-level rules are the supported alternative; no external I/O.
COPYRIGHT: Fytala
LICENSE: license.md (Apache-2.0)
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
Change History: Charles Korthout | 0.1 | 12-10-2026 | Creation
Input: batch/invoice attributes and ordered line/@sku values. Output: text report.
Invoice and line rules share the export mode. Explicit mode or #current retains
export dispatch during recursion; omitted mode uses the lexical default instead.
These projections do not validate invoice data or enforce enclosing-mode isolation.
-->
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:erp="urn:example:erp" xmlns:q="urn:example:erp" version="4.0">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <xsl:mode name="erp:export">
    <xsl:template match="invoice">
      <xsl:value-of select="concat(@id, ':', @currency, ':')"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="line"/>
      <xsl:text>;</xsl:text>
    </xsl:template>
    <xsl:template match="line">
      <xsl:value-of select="concat(@sku, '/')"/>
    </xsl:template>
  </xsl:mode>
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:apply-templates select="batch/invoice" mode="erp:export"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
```

Observed outcome: `XTSE0260`. No export result is asserted for this failing case.

### Complete portable XSLT 3.0 alternative

[Top-level named rules](../examples/enclosing-modes/portable3.xsl):

Input: batch/invoice attributes and ordered line/@sku values. Output: text report.
Invoice and line rules share the export mode. Explicit mode or #current retains
export dispatch during recursion; omitted mode uses the lexical default instead.
These projections do not validate invoice data or enforce enclosing-mode isolation.
-->
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:erp="urn:example:erp" xmlns:q="urn:example:erp" version="3.0">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <xsl:mode name="erp:export"/>
  <xsl:template match="invoice" mode="erp:export">
    <xsl:value-of select="concat(@id, ':', @currency, ':')"/>
    <xsl:apply-templates select="line" mode="erp:export"/>
    <xsl:text>;</xsl:text>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="line" mode="erp:export">
    <xsl:value-of select="concat(@sku, '/')"/>
  </xsl:template>

Principal text output:

```text
INV-2048:EUR:P100/P200/;INV-2049:USD:P300/;
```

The [version 4.0 comparison](../examples/enclosing-modes/portable4.xsl) returns the same report. The [current-mode fixture](../examples/enclosing-modes/current-mode.xsl) uses `#current` for line recursion and returns the same report despite a competing unnamed line rule.

### Omitted recursion mode boundary

Complete [omitted-mode fixture](../examples/enclosing-modes/omitted-recursion-mode.xsl):

```xml

COPYRIGHT: Fytala

export dispatch during recursion; omitted mode uses the lexical default instead.
These projections do not validate invoice data or enforce enclosing-mode isolation.

<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:erp="urn:example:erp" xmlns:q="urn:example:erp" version="3.0">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <xsl:mode name="erp:export"/>

    <xsl:value-of select="concat(@id, ':', @currency, ':')"/>

  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="line" mode="erp:export">
    <xsl:value-of select="concat(@sku, '/')"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="line">
    <xsl:text>wrong/</xsl:text>

Output:

```text
INV-2048:EUR:wrong/wrong/;INV-2049:USD:wrong/;
```

The [lexical default fixture](../examples/enclosing-modes/lexical-default-mode.xsl) sets the root `default-mode` to export and obtains the export report with omitted recursion. That is an explicit lexical policy, not enclosing-mode support.

### Empty and reordered input

Complete empty input:

```xml
<batch/>
```

Output is the empty string (zero principal text bytes). Complete reordered input:

```xml
<batch><invoice id="INV-2049" currency="USD"><line sku="P300"/></invoice><invoice id="INV-2048" currency="EUR"><line sku="P200"/><line sku="P100"/></invoice></batch>
```

Output:

```text
INV-2049:USD:P300/;INV-2048:EUR:P200/P100/;
```

The reverse-selection fixture reverses invoices without reversing their line sequence. The audit fixture reports `audit:INV-2048:2;audit:INV-2049:1;`, using its own top-level mode rules.

deferred/external-input-functions.md.text:
External-input function boundaries

Out-of-scope proposals — verified narrower processing paths

## 1. Name and Classification **External-input function proposals — Out of scope in the original dossier; absent in the reviewed Bosak paths.** Covers `fn:parse-html`, `fn:html-doc`, `fn:invisible-xml`, `fn:unparsed-binary` and `fn:xsd-validator`. The [REQ-118 decision](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) is preserved. Engine 1.1.2 reviewed against [revision bce0d9b1](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55). Primary function documentation: [parse-html](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-parse-html), [html-doc](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-html-doc), [invisible-xml](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-invisible-xml), [unparsed-binary](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-unparsed-binary), [xsd-validator](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-xsd-validator). Immutable review source: [QT4CG function catalog at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xpath-functions-40/src/function-catalog.xml), the five corresponding `fos:function` elements. The pin is a review source, not recovery of the missing adopted snapshot. ## 2. Intent Define a practical boundary between acquisition, format-specific parsing, schema validation and ordinary XPath processing of normalized partner invoice data. ## 3. Also Known As HTML parsing/loading, Invisible XML parser factories, binary resource loading and schema-validator factories. These are different services; accepting XML, binary atomic values or guarded records does not implement them. ## 4. History / Supersedes REQ-118 excluded these functions from its implementation schedule. This review checks current absence rather than repeating the exclusion as a timeless claim. It does not remove existing XML, schema-aware XSLT/XQuery or binary-value support. No external library is installed and no engine feature is added. ## 5. Motivation Partner invoices may arrive as an HTML fragment, an HTML URL, an attached PDF, a fixed text record or XML requiring schema validation. A consumer needs to know which work happens before Bosak evaluates XPath, and what remains a distinct service. The examples normalize invoice identity, currency and precomputed total; they do not calculate tax or exchange rates. ## 6. Language Alignment | Function | Draft call arities reviewed | Verified Bosak boundary | |---|---|---| | parse-html | 1, 2 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty | | html-doc | 1, 2 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty | | invisible-xml | 0, 1, 2 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty | | unparsed-binary | 1 | Call refuses `XPST0017`; lookup empty | | xsd-validator | 0, 1 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty | All listed calls are tested in default 3.1, frozen 4.0 and experimental modes. Lookup is tested in 3.1 and 4.0. These are missing-name results, not draft runtime errors. The factory's returned function is never invoked. Resource URLs use the reserved example domain; no network acquisition occurs in these checks. ## 7. Applicability Use this reference when planning a partner import boundary. Keep acquisition and non-XML parsing in an explicitly selected host component, then pass supported values or normalized XML into Bosak. For XSD requirements use the existing schema-aware integration paths where applicable or an external validator with a defined contract; the business guard here is only an example of application validation. ## 8. Structure | Function | Pinned contract | Dependency, ownership and supported alternative | |---|---|---| | parse-html | Accepts optional string/hexBinary/base64Binary and options; returns an HTML document node or empty | Requires an HTML parsing/recovery component and decisions about options, encoding and DOM-to-XDM mapping. The integration host owns normalization today; parse-xml accepts only well-formed XML | | html-doc | Optional resource string and options; specified using unparsed-binary followed by parse-html | Combines resource acquisition and HTML parsing. The host owns credentials, URI resolution and acquisition policy plus the HTML component. Supplying normalized XML avoids neither of those responsibilities | | invisible-xml | Optional grammar and options; returns a parsing function taking a string and returning an item | Needs an Invisible XML processor, grammar lifecycle and error-result mapping. The host owns the chosen processor. A fixed pipe-delimited record expression is only a narrow alternative for the declared format | | unparsed-binary | Optional resource string; returns optional base64Binary content | Does not inherently require a third-party parser. Integration needs binary acquisition, URI/base handling, resource policy and error semantics. The host acquires bytes; existing binary casts work on values already supplied | | xsd-validator | Optional options; returns a validator function producing an optional validation-result record | Existing schema machinery is relevant, but not this factory/result-record contract. Ownership must cover schema resolution, options, annotations and validation reporting. Existing schema-aware layers or a host validator are distinct paths | Absence of these names is not a promise that proposed dependency work must occur in a particular layer. Any future implementation needs its own design and tests. The original HTML note about blocked remote HTTP is an environment observation, not a reason to infer that local HTML parsing would fail. The pinned Invisible XML contract specifies FOIX0003 when no processor is available; Bosak instead refuses the unregistered name with XPST0017. This review does not certify the other functions' draft error matrices or option maps. ## 9. Participants The integration host acquires source content and selects the format parser/validator. Bosak receives normalized XML or atomic values. An invoice report expression reads ID, currency and total. A manifest records exact refused calls and supported narrower alternatives. ## 10. Collaborations The normalized-XML path parses a complete supplied batch and produces currency-labelled scalar rows. The fixed-record path splits exactly three unquoted fields. The binary path converts a supplied hex value to base64. The invoice guard checks explicit business predicates and reports a named application error. None invokes an unavailable draft function. ## 11. Consequences The examples establish useful processing paths without substituting for HTML recovery, arbitrary grammar parsing, binary IO or XSD validation. The guard supports only EUR/USD and nonnegative decimal totals with a nonempty ID; it does not check uniqueness, arbitrary XML structure, schema defaults or type annotations. The fixed record permits no embedded pipe, quoted/escaped field or multiline input. Those formats need a parser designed for them. ## 12. Implementation The inspected [FunctionLibrary.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Functions/FunctionLibrary.cs) contains no registration of the five names. [CatalogExampleTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/Documentation/CatalogExampleTests.cs) executes the manifest's name/arity refusals and alternative outcomes. This slice changes documentation/fixtures only. Existing named evidence: `ParseXml` in [FunctionLibraryTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.XPath.Standard.Tests/FunctionLibraryTests.cs), `Binary_HexAndBase64ComparableByOctets` in [AtomicEqualTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.XPath.Standard.Tests/AtomicEqualTests.cs), and `Copy_ValidationStrict_Valid_Succeeds` / `Copy_ValidationStrict_Invalid_Xtte1510` in [SchemaAwareValidationTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/SchemaAwareValidationTests.cs). Those establish existing narrower paths; they do not prove these factory functions. Read [integration](../../INTEGRATION.md) for the schema/resource API contract. No route or extension function is advertised for the absent names. 55 new checks comprise 30 calls, ten lookup outcomes and fifteen alternative/edge cases. The 117 registered-name audit remains unchanged: these absent proposals are outside that scoped inventory. ## 13. Sample Code The partner's fragment can contain HTML that is not XML: ```html

Invoice
INV-1042

``` The complete [XML refusal expression](../examples/external-input-functions/xml-is-not-html.xpath) raises `FODC0006`; parse-xml is not an HTML5 parser. The integration host instead supplies a well-formed normalized invoice batch: ```xml ``` Complete portable XPath 3.1 report: ```xpath (: Host supplies well-formed invoice XML after acquisition/HTML normalization. :) let $batch := parse-xml('') return string-join($batch/invoices/invoice ! concat(@id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal(@total), '0.00')), ';') ``` Exact output: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1043/USD:12.00 ``` Empty input: ```xml ``` The [complete empty expression](../examples/external-input-functions/normalized-xml-empty.xpath) returns the empty string. Reordered input: ```xml ``` The [complete reordered expression](../examples/external-input-functions/normalized-xml-reordered.xpath) returns: ```text INV-1043/USD:12.00;INV-1042/EUR:30.00 ``` Fixed partner text record: ```text INV-1042|EUR|30.00 ``` Complete narrow alternative to a grammar-parser factory: ```xpath (: Fixed three-field partner record; no quotes, escapes, embedded pipes or grammar parser. :) let $record := 'INV-1042|EUR|30.00' return if ($record eq '') then '' else let $fields := tokenize($record, '\|') return concat($fields[1], '/', $fields[2], ':', format-number(xs:decimal($fields[3]), '0.00')) ``` Exact output: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00 ``` Already-acquired attachment bytes (the eight-byte `%PDF-1.7` prefix only, not a complete PDF or PDF validation): ```xpath (: Bytes already acquired by the host; this cast does not fetch a resource. :) string(xs:base64Binary(xs:hexBinary('255044462D312E37'))) ``` Exact base64 output: ```text JVBERi0xLjc= ``` Explicit business guard for an already parsed invoice: ```xml ``` Complete guard expression: ```xpath (: Business guard only; does not validate XSD or annotate nodes. :) let $invoice := parse-xml('')/invoice return if (string-length(string($invoice/@id)) gt 0 and $invoice/@currency = ('EUR','USD') and $invoice/@total castable as xs:decimal) then if (xs:decimal($invoice/@total) ge 0) then concat($invoice/@id, '/', $invoice/@currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal($invoice/@total), '0.00')) else error(QName('urn:invoice', 'INVALID-INVOICE')) else error(QName('urn:invoice', 'INVALID-INVOICE')) ``` Exact output: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00 ``` A zero total remains valid: ```xml ``` Exact [zero guard](../examples/external-input-functions/invoice-guard-zero.xpath) output: ```text INV-1043/USD:0.00 ``` Invalid and missing business fields: ```xml ``` ```xml ``` Their complete [invalid](../examples/external-input-functions/invoice-guard-invalid.xpath) and [missing-field](../examples/external-input-functions/invoice-guard-empty.xpath) expressions report `INVALID-INVOICE`. This is an application error, not an XSD error. All fixtures below are linked in full. Lookup output 0 counts the absent functions across the listed arities. sections.1:
**External-input function proposals — Out of scope in the original dossier; absent in the reviewed Bosak paths.** Covers `fn:parse-html`, `fn:html-doc`, `fn:invisible-xml`, `fn:unparsed-binary` and `fn:xsd-validator`. The [REQ-118 decision](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) is preserved. Engine 1.1.2 reviewed against [revision bce0d9b1](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55).

Primary function documentation: [parse-html](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-parse-html), [html-doc](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-html-doc), [invisible-xml](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-invisible-xml), [unparsed-binary](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-unparsed-binary), [xsd-validator](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xpath-functions-40/Overview.html#func-xsd-validator). Immutable review source: [QT4CG function catalog at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xpath-functions-40/src/function-catalog.xml), the five corresponding `fos:function` elements. The pin is a review source, not recovery of the missing adopted snapshot.
sections.2: Define a practical boundary between acquisition, format-specific parsing, schema validation and ordinary XPath processing of normalized partner invoice data.
sections.3: HTML parsing/loading, Invisible XML parser factories, binary resource loading and schema-validator factories. These are different services; accepting XML, binary atomic values or guarded records does not implement them.
sections.4: REQ-118 excluded these functions from its implementation schedule. This review checks current absence rather than repeating the exclusion as a timeless claim. It does not remove existing XML, schema-aware XSLT/XQuery or binary-value support. No external library is installed and no engine feature is added.
sections.5: Partner invoices may arrive as an HTML fragment, an HTML URL, an attached PDF, a fixed text record or XML requiring schema validation. A consumer needs to know which work happens before Bosak evaluates XPath, and what remains a distinct service. The examples normalize invoice identity, currency and precomputed total; they do not calculate tax or exchange rates.
sections.6:
| Function | Draft call arities reviewed | Verified Bosak boundary |
|---|---|---|
| parse-html | 1, 2 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty |
| html-doc | 1, 2 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty |
| invisible-xml | 0, 1, 2 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty |
| unparsed-binary | 1 | Call refuses `XPST0017`; lookup empty |
| xsd-validator | 0, 1 | Calls refuse `XPST0017`; lookup empty |

All listed calls are tested in default 3.1, frozen 4.0 and experimental modes. Lookup is tested in 3.1 and 4.0. These are missing-name results, not draft runtime errors. The factory's returned function is never invoked. Resource URLs use the reserved example domain; no network acquisition occurs in these checks.
sections.7: Use this reference when planning a partner import boundary. Keep acquisition and non-XML parsing in an explicitly selected host component, then pass supported values or normalized XML into Bosak. For XSD requirements use the existing schema-aware integration paths where applicable or an external validator with a defined contract; the business guard here is only an example of application validation.
sections.8:
| Function | Pinned contract | Dependency, ownership and supported alternative |
|---|---|---|
| parse-html | Accepts optional string/hexBinary/base64Binary and options; returns an HTML document node or empty | Requires an HTML parsing/recovery component and decisions about options, encoding and DOM-to-XDM mapping. The integration host owns normalization today; parse-xml accepts only well-formed XML |
| html-doc | Optional resource string and options; specified using unparsed-binary followed by parse-html | Combines resource acquisition and HTML parsing. The host owns credentials, URI resolution and acquisition policy plus the HTML component. Supplying normalized XML avoids neither of those responsibilities |
| invisible-xml | Optional grammar and options; returns a parsing function taking a string and returning an item | Needs an Invisible XML processor, grammar lifecycle and error-result mapping. The host owns the chosen processor. A fixed pipe-delimited record expression is only a narrow alternative for the declared format |
| unparsed-binary | Optional resource string; returns optional base64Binary content | Does not inherently require a third-party parser. Integration needs binary acquisition, URI/base handling, resource policy and error semantics. The host acquires bytes; existing binary casts work on values already supplied |
| xsd-validator | Optional options; returns a validator function producing an optional validation-result record | Existing schema machinery is relevant, but not this factory/result-record contract. Ownership must cover schema resolution, options, annotations and validation reporting. Existing schema-aware layers or a host validator are distinct paths |

Absence of these names is not a promise that proposed dependency work must occur in a particular layer. Any future implementation needs its own design and tests. The original HTML note about blocked remote HTTP is an environment observation, not a reason to infer that local HTML parsing would fail.

The pinned Invisible XML contract specifies FOIX0003 when no processor is available; Bosak instead refuses the unregistered name with XPST0017. This review does not certify the other functions' draft error matrices or option maps.
sections.9: The integration host acquires source content and selects the format parser/validator. Bosak receives normalized XML or atomic values. An invoice report expression reads ID, currency and total. A manifest records exact refused calls and supported narrower alternatives.
sections.10: The normalized-XML path parses a complete supplied batch and produces currency-labelled scalar rows. The fixed-record path splits exactly three unquoted fields. The binary path converts a supplied hex value to base64. The invoice guard checks explicit business predicates and reports a named application error. None invokes an unavailable draft function.
sections.11: The examples establish useful processing paths without substituting for HTML recovery, arbitrary grammar parsing, binary IO or XSD validation. The guard supports only EUR/USD and nonnegative decimal totals with a nonempty ID; it does not check uniqueness, arbitrary XML structure, schema defaults or type annotations. The fixed record permits no embedded pipe, quoted/escaped field or multiline input. Those formats need a parser designed for them.
sections.12:
The inspected [FunctionLibrary.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Functions/FunctionLibrary.cs) contains no registration of the five names. [CatalogExampleTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/Documentation/CatalogExampleTests.cs) executes the manifest's name/arity refusals and alternative outcomes. This slice changes documentation/fixtures only.

Existing named evidence: `ParseXml` in [FunctionLibraryTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.XPath.Standard.Tests/FunctionLibraryTests.cs), `Binary_HexAndBase64ComparableByOctets` in [AtomicEqualTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.XPath.Standard.Tests/AtomicEqualTests.cs), and `Copy_ValidationStrict_Valid_Succeeds` / `Copy_ValidationStrict_Invalid_Xtte1510` in [SchemaAwareValidationTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/bce0d9b1e21ce2ed875821e592f64bf2ed69ee55/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/SchemaAwareValidationTests.cs). Those establish existing narrower paths; they do not prove these factory functions. Read [integration](../../INTEGRATION.md) for the schema/resource API contract. No route or extension function is advertised for the absent names.

55 new checks comprise 30 calls, ten lookup outcomes and fifteen alternative/edge cases. The 117 registered-name audit remains unchanged: these absent proposals are outside that scoped inventory.
sections.13:
The partner's fragment can contain HTML that is not XML: ```html

Invoice
INV-1042

``` The complete [XML refusal expression](../examples/external-input-functions/xml-is-not-html.xpath) raises `FODC0006`; parse-xml is not an HTML5 parser. The integration host instead supplies a well-formed normalized invoice batch: ```xml ``` Complete portable XPath 3.1 report: ```xpath (: Host supplies well-formed invoice XML after acquisition/HTML normalization. :) let $batch := parse-xml('') return string-join($batch/invoices/invoice ! concat(@id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal(@total), '0.00')), ';') ``` Exact output: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1043/USD:12.00 ``` Empty input: ```xml ``` The [complete empty expression](../examples/external-input-functions/normalized-xml-empty.xpath) returns the empty string. Reordered input: ```xml ``` The [complete reordered expression](../examples/external-input-functions/normalized-xml-reordered.xpath) returns: ```text INV-1043/USD:12.00;INV-1042/EUR:30.00 ``` Fixed partner text record: ```text INV-1042|EUR|30.00 ``` Complete narrow alternative to a grammar-parser factory: ```xpath (: Fixed three-field partner record; no quotes, escapes, embedded pipes or grammar parser. :) let $record := 'INV-1042|EUR|30.00' return if ($record eq '') then '' else let $fields := tokenize($record, '\|') return concat($fields[1], '/', $fields[2], ':', format-number(xs:decimal($fields[3]), '0.00')) ``` Exact output: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00 ``` Already-acquired attachment bytes (the eight-byte `%PDF-1.7` prefix only, not a complete PDF or PDF validation): ```xpath (: Bytes already acquired by the host; this cast does not fetch a resource. :) string(xs:base64Binary(xs:hexBinary('255044462D312E37'))) ``` Exact base64 output: ```text JVBERi0xLjc= ``` Explicit business guard for an already parsed invoice: ```xml ``` Complete guard expression: ```xpath (: Business guard only; does not validate XSD or annotate nodes. :) let $invoice := parse-xml('')/invoice return if (string-length(string($invoice/@id)) gt 0 and $invoice/@currency = ('EUR','USD') and $invoice/@total castable as xs:decimal) then if (xs:decimal($invoice/@total) ge 0) then concat($invoice/@id, '/', $invoice/@currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal($invoice/@total), '0.00')) else error(QName('urn:invoice', 'INVALID-INVOICE')) else error(QName('urn:invoice', 'INVALID-INVOICE')) ``` Exact output: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00 ``` A zero total remains valid: ```xml ``` Exact [zero guard](../examples/external-input-functions/invoice-guard-zero.xpath) output: ```text INV-1043/USD:0.00 ``` Invalid and missing business fields: ```xml ``` ```xml ``` Their complete [invalid](../examples/external-input-functions/invoice-guard-invalid.xpath) and [missing-field](../examples/external-input-functions/invoice-guard-empty.xpath) expressions report `INVALID-INVOICE`. deferred/fn-apply-templates.md.text:
fn:apply-templates

Deferred — instruction and stylesheet-function alternatives

## 1. Name and Classification **fn:apply-templates — Deferred.** The [REQ-118 tier-4 decision](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) remains in force. Bosak engine 1.1.2 reviewed against [revision 7758c568](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/7758c568612a19781c36bb1ca30c01e973a6246a). Primary documentation: [XSLT 4.0 function](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-40/Overview.html#func-apply-templates) and [XSLT 3.0 instruction](https://www.w3.org/TR/xslt-30/#element-apply-templates). Immutable review sources: [XSLT function catalog at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-40/src/function-catalog.xml), function `apply-templates`, and [xslt.xml at the same pin](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-40/src/xslt.xml), section `func-apply-templates`. This review pin does not recover the historical adopted snapshot. ## 2. Intent Invoke template rules inside an expression, retaining their returned values for construction of a report, map or array. ## 3. Also Known As Expression-based template dispatch. The function in the `fn` namespace is distinct from the supported `xsl:apply-templates` instruction and a user-defined stylesheet function. ## 4. History / Supersedes The pinned draft records introduction under issues 2005/2038 and PR 2006 (May 2025). The function supplements the instruction; it does not replace existing template dispatch. Bosak retains the deferral. ## 5. Motivation An ERP integration exports invoice totals while sharing template rules with other report builders. Expression composition is convenient when each invoice becomes a map or array member. The worked example keeps currency with each amount and does not sum across currencies or claim tax, discounts or currency conversion. ## 6. Language Alignment | Form | Verified Bosak result | |---|---| | Standalone XPath calls, arities 1/2, modes 3.1, frozen 4.0 and experimental | `XPST0017`; standalone XPath also lacks the XSLT rule environment required by the draft | | XSLT versions 3.0/4.0: arities 1/2 and `fn:apply-templates#1` | `XPST0017` | | XPath `function-lookup`, arities 1/2, modes 3.1/4.0 | Both absent; count `0` | | XSLT availability | Instruction `true`, function arities 1/2 `false` | | Instruction and `f:export` wrapper | Verified with named mode, ordinary/tunnel parameters, empty/reordered input | Error fixtures assert a reported marker from compilation or capture, without promising a detection stage. ## 7. Applicability Use an explicit instruction today. Use a stylesheet-function wrapper when an expression needs the result sequence. This example fixes the export mode and parameter names; it does not implement dynamic mode/parameter-map dispatch. ## 8. Structure The draft signature is `fn:apply-templates($select as item()*, $options as map(*)? := {}) as item()*`. It dispatches each selected item and concatenates the rule results in selection order. The options are `params` and `tunnel-params` (QName-keyed maps), and `mode` (QName, `#current` or `#unnamed`, default `#unnamed`). The pinned draft requires a declared/accepted public mode and specifies `XTDE0565` for unavailable/private modes. These draft contracts are reference requirements, not verified Bosak function behavior. The one-argument prose equates the call with an instruction omitting mode, while the options table defaults to `#unnamed`; reconcile this against the implementation target before adding support. The alternatives use an explicit named mode. ## 9. Participants Invoice nodes provide ID, currency, quantities and decimal prices. The export rule calculates a currency-labelled amount. The caller supplies an ordinary label and a tunnel batch identifier. The wrapper returns strings; the output step joins them explicitly. ## 10. Collaborations The wrapper accepts nodes and values explicitly, executes the instruction in `f:export`, passes `label` and tunnel `batch`, and returns the atomic sequence. The caller uses `string-join` rather than relying on serialization spacing. ## 11. Consequences The wrapper preserves a useful composition path with existing XSLT support. It is not an implementation of the draft function: dynamic options, public-mode validation, package acceptance and function-specific errors remain deferred. sections.1:
**fn:apply-templates — Deferred.** The [REQ-118 tier-4 decision](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) remains in force. Bosak engine 1.1.2 reviewed against [revision 7758c568](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/7758c568612a19781c36bb1ca30c01e973a6246a).

Primary documentation: [XSLT 4.0 function](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-40/Overview.html#func-apply-templates) and [XSLT 3.0 instruction](https://www.w3.org/TR/xslt-30/#element-apply-templates). Immutable review sources: [XSLT function catalog at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-40/src/function-catalog.xml), function `apply-templates`, and [xslt.xml at the same pin](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-40/src/xslt.xml), section `func-apply-templates`. This review pin does not recover the historical adopted snapshot.
sections.2: Invoke template rules inside an expression, retaining their returned values for construction of a report, map or array.
sections.3: Expression-based template dispatch. The function in the `fn` namespace is distinct from the supported `xsl:apply-templates` instruction and a user-defined stylesheet function.
sections.4: The pinned draft records introduction under issues 2005/2038 and PR 2006 (May 2025). The function supplements the instruction; it does not replace existing template dispatch. Bosak retains the deferral.
sections.5: An ERP integration exports invoice totals while sharing template rules with other report builders. Expression composition is convenient when each invoice becomes a map or array member. The worked example keeps currency with each amount and does not sum across currencies or claim tax, discounts or currency conversion.
sections.6:
| Form | Verified Bosak result |
|---|---|
| Standalone XPath calls, arities 1/2, modes 3.1, frozen 4.0 and experimental | `XPST0017`; standalone XPath also lacks the XSLT rule environment required by the draft |
| XSLT versions 3.0/4.0: arities 1/2 and `fn:apply-templates#1` | `XPST0017` |
| XPath `function-lookup`, arities 1/2, modes 3.1/4.0 | Both absent; count `0` |
| XSLT availability | Instruction `true`, function arities 1/2 `false` |
| Instruction and `f:export` wrapper | Verified with named mode, ordinary/tunnel parameters, empty/reordered input |

Error fixtures assert a reported marker from compilation or capture, without promising a detection stage.
sections.7: Use an explicit instruction today. Use a stylesheet-function wrapper when an expression needs the result sequence. This example fixes the export mode and parameter names; it does not implement dynamic mode/parameter-map dispatch.
sections.8:
The draft signature is `fn:apply-templates($select as item()*, $options as map(*)? := {}) as item()*`. It dispatches each selected item and concatenates the rule results in selection order. The options are `params` and `tunnel-params` (QName-keyed maps), and `mode` (QName, `#current` or `#unnamed`, default `#unnamed`). The pinned draft requires a declared/accepted public mode and specifies `XTDE0565` for unavailable/private modes.

These draft contracts are reference requirements, not verified Bosak function behavior. The one-argument prose equates the call with an instruction omitting mode, while the options table defaults to `#unnamed`; reconcile this against the implementation target before adding support. The alternatives use an explicit named mode.
sections.9: Invoice nodes provide ID, currency, quantities and decimal prices. The export rule calculates a currency-labelled amount. The caller supplies an ordinary label and a tunnel batch identifier. The wrapper returns strings; the output step joins them explicitly.
sections.10: The wrapper accepts nodes and values explicitly, executes the instruction in `f:export`, passes `label` and tunnel `batch`, and returns the atomic sequence. The caller uses `string-join` rather than relying on serialization spacing.
sections.11: The wrapper preserves a useful composition path with existing XSLT support. It is not an implementation of the draft function: dynamic options, public-mode validation, package acceptance and function-specific errors remain deferred. Empty input returns no rows; reordered input retains invoice order. Invoice line order does not change the decimal sum.

sections.13:
The source represents two invoices in different currencies. INV-1042 totals `2 × 12.50 + 1 × 5 = 30.00 EUR`; INV-1043 totals `3 × 4 = 12.00 USD`.

```xml
<invoices><invoice id="INV-1042" currency="EUR"><line sku="FILTER" quantity="2" price="12.50"/><line sku="BLUE" quantity="1" price="5"/></invoice><invoice id="INV-1043" currency="USD"><line sku="SEAL" quantity="3" price="4"/></invoice></invoices>
```

Refused XSLT 4.0 expression (result `XPST0017`):

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
AUTHOR: Charles Korthout
CREATE DATE: 12 October 2026
PURPOSE: Verify invoice template dispatch and the deferred fn:apply-templates boundary.
SPECIAL NOTES: In-memory catalog example; no streaming or draft function conformance claim.
COPYRIGHT: Fytala
LICENSE: license.md (Apache-2.0)
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
Change History: Charles Korthout | 0.1 | 12-10-2026 | Creation
Input: invoice batch. Output: exact text report or declared refusal marker.
Empty input returns an empty report; reordered input retains selection order.
-->
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:f="urn:invoice" version="4.0" exclude-result-prefixes="xs f">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:sequence xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions" select="fn:apply-templates(invoices/invoice, map{'mode': QName('urn:invoice','export')})"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
```

Portable XSLT 3.0 instruction alternative:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
AUTHOR: Charles Korthout
CREATE DATE: 12 October 2026
PURPOSE: Verify invoice template dispatch and the deferred fn:apply-templates boundary.
SPECIAL NOTES: In-memory catalog example; no streaming or draft function conformance claim.
COPYRIGHT: Fytala
LICENSE: license.md (Apache-2.0)
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
Change History: Charles Korthout | 0.1 | 12-10-2026 | Creation
Input: invoice batch. Output: exact text report or declared refusal marker.
Empty input returns an empty report; reordered input retains selection order.
-->
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:f="urn:invoice" version="3.0" exclude-result-prefixes="xs f">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <!-- Explicit export mode keeps dispatch independent of the caller's mode. -->
  <xsl:mode name="f:export"/>
  <xsl:template match="invoice" mode="f:export">
    <xsl:param name="label" as="xs:string"/>
    <xsl:param name="batch" as="xs:string" tunnel="yes"/>
    <xsl:sequence select="concat($batch, '/', $label, '/', @id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(sum(line ! (xs:decimal(@quantity) * xs:decimal(@price))), '0.00'), ';')"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:variable name="rows" as="xs:string*">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="invoices/invoice" mode="f:export">
        <xsl:with-param name="label" select="'EXPORT'"/>
        <xsl:with-param name="batch" select="'BATCH-7'" tunnel="yes"/>
      </xsl:apply-templates>
    </xsl:variable>
    <xsl:value-of select="string-join($rows, '')"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
```

Portable stylesheet-function alternative, usable from XPath expressions inside the stylesheet:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
AUTHOR: Charles Korthout
CREATE DATE: 12 October 2026
PURPOSE: Verify invoice template dispatch and the deferred fn:apply-templates boundary.
SPECIAL NOTES: In-memory catalog example; no streaming or draft function conformance claim.
COPYRIGHT: Fytala
LICENSE: license.md (Apache-2.0)
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
Change History: Charles Korthout | 0.1 | 12-10-2026 | Creation
Input: invoice batch. Output: exact text report or declared refusal marker.
Empty input returns an empty report; reordered input retains selection order.
-->
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:f="urn:invoice" version="3.0" exclude-result-prefixes="xs f">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <!-- Explicit export mode keeps dispatch independent of the caller's mode. -->
  <xsl:mode name="f:export"/>
  <xsl:template match="invoice" mode="f:export">
    <xsl:param name="label" as="xs:string"/>
    <xsl:param name="batch" as="xs:string" tunnel="yes"/>
    <xsl:sequence select="concat($batch, '/', $label, '/', @id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(sum(line ! (xs:decimal(@quantity) * xs:decimal(@price))), '0.00'), ';')"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- The wrapper is a user function, not registration of the draft fn function. -->
  <xsl:function name="f:export" as="xs:string*">
    <xsl:param name="nodes" as="element(invoice)*"/>
    <xsl:param name="label" as="xs:string"/>
    <xsl:param name="batch" as="xs:string"/>
    <xsl:apply-templates select="$nodes" mode="f:export">
      <xsl:with-param name="label" select="$label"/>
      <xsl:with-param name="batch" select="$batch" tunnel="yes"/>
    </xsl:apply-templates>
  </xsl:function>
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:value-of select="string-join(f:export(invoices/invoice, 'EXPORT', 'BATCH-7'), '')"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
```

XQuery and streaming scope

Existing APIs — separate 4.0 language and module deltas

## 1. Name and Classification **XQuery and streaming language boundaries — Existing support; 4.0 deltas outside the original schedule.** Reviewed engine 1.1.2 at [revision 2184e920](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/2184e9200394ca2e06f720bb9cdb95afd927aa51) on 2026-10-12. The [REQ-118 exclusion](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) does not mean that XQuery FLWOR or streaming input is absent. Primary references: [XQuery 4.0 version declaration](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xquery-40/xquery-40.html#id-version-declaration), [XQuery 3.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/xquery-31/), [XSLT Streaming 4.0](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-streaming-40/Overview.html), [XSLT 3.0 streaming](https://www.w3.org/TR/xslt-30/#streaming). Immutable review sources: [query-prolog.xml at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xquery-40/src/query-prolog.xml), section `id-version-declaration`, and [streaming XML at the same pin](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-streaming-40/src/xslt-streaming.xml), sections `intro`, `initiating-streaming` and `streaming-non-xml`. The review pin does not recover missing historical adopted snapshots. ## 2. Intent Select the correct query or transformation API for partner invoice processing and distinguish existing capabilities from a complete 4.0 language/module implementation. ## 3. Also Known As XQuery FLWOR processing, XPath clause boundaries, burst-mode XML streaming and Streaming 4.0 module scope. A stylesheet version number or a few 4.0 functions do not certify a complete language version. ## 4. History / Supersedes REQ-118 excluded XQuery 4.0-only changes and Streaming 4.0 deltas. Existing XQuery 3.1 and streamed XML transformations predate this review. REQ-087 Phase D is marked Done in the registry; its dated residual reports are historical evidence, not a newly verified current failure count or a reason to call all streaming absent. Any remaining 4.0 delta needs a separately defined implementation/conformance slice. ## 5. Motivation An ERP report needs positive invoices sorted by currency and ID, which fits XQuery FLWOR. A large invoice feed can instead be processed in arrival order by a streamed transformation. Sorting the entire feed and reporting it in a forward pass have different resource contracts; this reference keeps those choices concrete. ## 6. Language Alignment | Path | Verified behavior | |---|---| | XQueryCompiler, xquery version 3.1 | Full invoice where/order-by query succeeds | | XQueryCompiler, xquery version 4.0 | `XQST0031` | | Simple XPath for/where, modes 3.1/4.0/experimental | Bosak accepts the tested extension and returns `3|2` | | Tested XPath order-by/group-by forms, same modes | `XPST0003` | | Portable XPath 3.1 predicate + sort | Same sorted invoice rows for main/empty/reordered input | | Ordinary XSLT capture, stylesheet 3.0/4.0 | Arrival-order invoice reports succeed | | TransformStreamingToString, same stylesheets | Same exact reports through the actual streaming input API | The XPath where acceptance corrects older blanket dossier wording. It is observed Bosak behavior, not a claim that XPath 3.1's standard grammar includes a full FLWOR. XQuery version rejection does not enumerate all 4.0 feature gaps. ## 7. Applicability Use XQueryCompiler for full FLWOR, constructors, modules and the existing XQuery surface. Use XPath31Expression for expressions with declared compatibility. Choose TransformStreamingToString when the host supplies a stream and the transformation fits its provider constraints; use ordinary transforms for grounded input. Treat Streaming 4.0 delta planning as a separate effort. ## 8. Structure The pinned XQuery version declaration identifies module intent; Bosak's parser accepts 1.0/3.0/3.1 and rejects the tested 4.0 declaration. Shared parsing/runtime code does not make both public APIs the same language. The Streaming 4.0 module separates optional streaming from the main XSLT specification. Its pinned status text says streamability of all new 4.0 constructs is still work in progress. It includes XML/non-XML, streamability, maps/arrays and other contracts; a successful XML forward pass cannot certify them all. Our two business outputs deliberately differ: the query filters zero totals and sorts; the streamed stylesheet emits all invoices in arrival order. The same-output comparison is between ordinary and streamed execution of the same stylesheet, not between these different business tasks. ## 9. Participants XQueryCompiler/XQueryContext compile and evaluate the query. XPath31Expression handles the portable alternative and clause probes. XsltCompiler/XsltExecutable compile the stylesheet and execute ordinary or streamed input. The test manifest selects the API explicitly; the integration host owns the source stream. ## 10. Collaborations The query parses the complete invoice XML, filters positive totals, orders by currency/ID and joins scalar rows. The portable XPath uses a predicate and sort key for this data contract. The stylesheet makes one report row per invoice. The harness runs it through capture and through File.OpenRead plus TransformStreamingToString, disposing the stream after use. ## 11. Consequences The existing query and streaming APIs are useful without promising XQuery 4.0 or complete Streaming 4.0 conformance. The sort-key alternative assumes the shown simple currency/ID strings; concatenated keys are not a universal replacement for multi-key collation ordering. The streamed report retains output text and does not establish a total-memory bound. Generic-node, capturing-accumulator and other separately recorded gaps remain relevant to future streaming work. ## 12. Implementation Reviewed source: [XQueryParser.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/2184e9200394ca2e06f720bb9cdb95afd927aa51/src/Bosak.XQuery/Parser/XQueryParser.cs) enforces supported version declarations; [XPathParser.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/2184e9200394ca2e06f720bb9cdb95afd927aa51/src/Bosak.XPath.Parser/Ast/XPathParser.cs) separates full-FLWOR branches while accepting the tested where clause. [XsltExecutable.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/2184e9200394ca2e06f720bb9cdb95afd927aa51/src/Bosak.Xslt/Api/XsltExecutable.cs) exposes actual streaming transforms, distinct from CaptureTransform. Existing named tests: `XQuery_OrderBy_WithWhere` and `XQuery_GroupBy_AggregatesNonGroupingVariables` in [PlaceholderTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/2184e9200394ca2e06f720bb9cdb95afd927aa51/tests/Bosak.XQuery.Tests/PlaceholderTests.cs); `ApplyTemplates_Parity`, `LastFunction_OverStream_RaisesStreamingError`, `SecondPassOverStream_RaisesForwardOnlyError` and `BoundedMemoryOverLargeStream` in [StreamingTransformTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/2184e9200394ca2e06f720bb9cdb95afd927aa51/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/StreamingTransformTests.cs). The bounded-memory test has its own 500,000-record/selective-output contract, not a guarantee for arbitrary output or sorting. Read [integration](../../INTEGRATION.md) and [REQ-087 registry](../../FEATURE_REQUESTS.md) for source/runtime constraints and dated history. The catalog harness adds xquery rows and stream31/stream40 dispatch metadata; these select actual public APIs. It also accepts an explicit frozenExpected outcome for an experimental probe already accepted by frozen 4.0. This is test infrastructure, not engine or compatibility-policy change. No manual gate promotion or new sweep is claimed. ## 13. Sample Code Complete invoice input; totals are precomputed and each amount retains its currency: ```xml ``` Complete XQuery 3.1 query: ```xquery (: XQuery 3.1: select positive invoices and sort by currency then identifier. :) xquery version "3.1"; let $batch := parse-xml('') return string-join((for $invoice in $batch/invoices/invoice where xs:decimal($invoice/@total) gt 0 order by string($invoice/@currency), string($invoice/@id) return concat($invoice/@id, '/', $invoice/@currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal($invoice/@total), '0.00'))), ';') ``` Complete portable XPath 3.1 alternative: ```xpath (: XPath 3.1: predicate filtering plus explicit sort key. :) let $batch := parse-xml('') return string-join(sort($batch/invoices/invoice[xs:decimal(@total) gt 0], (), function($invoice){concat($invoice/@currency, '/', $invoice/@id)}) ! concat(@id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal(@total), '0.00')), ';') ``` Both sorted positive-invoice reports return exactly: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1043/USD:12.00 ``` The version boundary is a separate complete query: ```xquery xquery version "4.0"; 1 ``` Result: `XQST0031`. Observed XPath where extension: ```xpath string-join((for $i in (3,1,2) where $i gt 1 return $i) ! string(.), '|') ``` Result: `3|2`, also checked at 4.0 and experimental. Complete forward-report stylesheet: ```xml ``` Compile it with XsltCompiler and call TransformStreamingToString with a readable stream containing the XML above. The manifest also executes the same business stylesheet through ordinary capture. Exact forward output: ```text INV-1043/USD:12.00;INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1044/EUR:0.00; ``` Empty input (all report paths return empty text): ```xml ``` Reordered input: ```xml ``` The query/portable reports retain the same sorted output. Ordinary/streamed stylesheets preserve reordered arrival order: ```text INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1043/USD:12.00;INV-1044/EUR:0.00; ``` All fixtures are linked below. xquery31/xquery40 selects XQueryCompiler; stream31/stream40 selects TransformStreamingToString; xslt31/xslt40 selects CaptureTransform. sections.13:
Complete invoice input; totals are precomputed and each amount retains its currency:

```xml
<invoices><invoice id="INV-1043" currency="USD" total="12"/><invoice id="INV-1042" currency="EUR" total="30"/><invoice id="INV-1044" currency="EUR" total="0"/></invoices>
```

Complete XQuery 3.1 query:

```xquery
(: XQuery 3.1: select positive invoices and sort by currency then identifier. :)
xquery version "3.1";
let $batch := parse-xml('<invoices><invoice id="INV-1043" currency="USD" total="12"/><invoice id="INV-1042" currency="EUR" total="30"/><invoice id="INV-1044" currency="EUR" total="0"/></invoices>')
return string-join((for $invoice in $batch/invoices/invoice
where xs:decimal($invoice/@total) gt 0
order by string($invoice/@currency), string($invoice/@id)
return concat($invoice/@id, '/', $invoice/@currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal($invoice/@total), '0.00'))), ';')
```

Complete portable XPath 3.1 alternative:

```xpath
(: XPath 3.1: predicate filtering plus explicit sort key. :)
let $batch := parse-xml('<invoices><invoice id="INV-1043" currency="USD" total="12"/><invoice id="INV-1042" currency="EUR" total="30"/><invoice id="INV-1044" currency="EUR" total="0"/></invoices>')
return string-join(sort($batch/invoices/invoice[xs:decimal(@total) gt 0], (), function($invoice){concat($invoice/@currency, '/', $invoice/@id)}) ! concat(@id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal(@total), '0.00')), ';')
```

Both sorted positive-invoice reports return exactly:

```text
INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1043/USD:12.00
```

The version boundary is a separate complete query:

```xquery
xquery version "4.0"; 1
```

Result: `XQST0031`. Observed XPath where extension:

```xpath
string-join((for $i in (3,1,2) where $i gt 1 return $i) ! string(.), '|')
```

AUTHOR: Charles Korthout
CREATE DATE: 12 October 2026
PURPOSE: Verify invoice processing through ordinary and streaming XSLT paths.
SPECIAL NOTES: Exact report parity does not certify Streaming 4.0 or memory bounds.
COPYRIGHT: Fytala
LICENSE: license.md (Apache-2.0)
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
Change History: Charles Korthout | 0.1 | 12-10-2026 | Creation
Input: invoice XML. Output: one currency-labelled row per invoice, or the declared error.
Empty batches return empty text; reordered batches retain input order.
-->

  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <!-- A forward pass reports every invoice; sorting is a separate buffered task. -->
    <xsl:for-each select="invoices/invoice">
      <xsl:value-of select="concat(@id, '/', @currency, ':', format-number(xs:decimal(@total), '0.00'), ';')"/>
    </xsl:for-each>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
```

```text
INV-1043/USD:12.00;INV-1042/EUR:30.00;INV-1044/EUR:0.00;
```

```

The query/portable reports retain the same sorted output. Ordinary/streamed stylesheets preserve reordered arrival order:

deferred/serialization-parameters.md.text:
Serialization 4.0 parameters

Deferred additions — existing serialization and portable invoice export

## 1. Name and Classification **Serialization 4.0 parameter additions — Deferred, with a supported XSLT solidus control.** [REQ-118 tier-4 decision](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) remains; it must not imply that all serialization is missing. Bosak engine 1.1.2 reviewed against [revision 23218073](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791). Primary references: [Serialization 4.0 parameters](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#serparam), [Serialization 3.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/xslt-xquery-serialization-31/). Immutable review source: [serialization XML at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/src/xslt-xquery-serialization.xml), section `serparam`. This is a review pin, not recovery of the missing historical adopted snapshot. ## 2. Intent Choose an invoice interchange format with predictable record boundaries, URI escaping and output layout. Record parameter-by-parameter behavior instead of equating accepted options with implemented serialization. ## 3. Also Known As Canonical output, JSON Lines, configurable indentation/line endings and CSV serialization controls. These are serialization parameters, distinct from XPath CSV parsing functions. ## 4. History / Supersedes The pinned source adds escape-solidus (issue 530/PR 534), json-lines (1471/1497), canonical (938/2259), layout controls (1234/2719) and CSV controls (2748/2794). This disposition covers those nine parameter additions, not every change to Serialization 4.0: GNodes, CSV data-model shapes, numeric/JSON rules, HTML defaults and other revisions require separate reviews. ## 5. Motivation A partner imports one JSON invoice per physical line. Invoice identifiers, currency-labelled totals and URIs must survive serialization. A pretty JSON array cannot substitute for JSON Lines. Canonical output has a different purpose—stable representation for signing/digesting—and must use a verified canonicalization implementation. ## 6. Language Alignment | Path | Verified boundary | |---|---| | `fn:serialize` maps in XPath 3.1/4.0 | Nine new keys leave tested output unchanged; map-valued invalid options are tolerated | | `fn:serialize` escape-solidus false | Still emits escaped solidus; tested default also escapes it | | XSLT 3.0/4.0 output escape-solidus yes/no | Controls URI string escaping in the verified JSON outputs | | `fn:serialize` json-lines true, two maps | `SERE0023` | | XSLT json-lines yes, two strings | JSON array `["INV-1042","INV-1043"]`, not separate lines | | `fn:serialize` method csv | Tested scalar sequence equals XML-family serialization; CSV is not established | | XSLT method csv | `XTSE1570` | | Explicit per-record serialization + LF joining | Portable invoice JSON Lines; empty and reordered cases verified | Successful XPath 4.0 probes also assert the same default 3.1 outcome. XSLT error fixtures assert markers from compilation or capture; no detection-stage promise follows. ## 7. Applicability Use existing XML/JSON/text serialization for ordinary exports. Build JSON Lines explicitly by serializing each record and joining the strings. Avoid these ignored options when a consumer requires canonical bytes, a custom layout or CSV. Do not assume that parser support for CSV delivers a CSV serializer. ## 8. Structure The pinned nine-parameter boundary is: | Parameter | Pinned draft contract | Bosak scope and evidence | |---|---|---| | [canonical](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_CANONICAL) | XML/XHTML Canonical XML 1.1; JSON canonicalization has its own rules | No handling in inspected option/property parsers. XML examples retain z-before-a attributes and an empty-element tag, so are not canonical XML | | [json-lines](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#id-json-lines) | Serialize top-level items as successive JSON records separated by line endings | No option handling; XPath error and XSLT array behavior differ | | [escape-solidus](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#JSON_ESCAPE-SOLIDUS) | Boolean controls escaping `/` as `\/` in JSON strings; adaptive has a separate parameter section | XSLT JSON yes/no verified; fn option ignored. Adaptive behavior not certified | | [indent-unit](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_INDENT-UNIT) | Spaces or tabs (including literal `\t` escape), when indent is true | No handling. Current equality probes use default indent=false and do not prove an indented-layout mismatch; source inspection establishes missing control | | [indent-attributes](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_INDENT-ATTRIBUTES) | Boolean refinement when indent=true; draft permits optional attribute line breaks | No handling. Absence of line breaks alone would not prove a draft violation | | [line-ending](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_LINE-ENDING) | LF, CR or CRLF; `\n`/`\r` escape notation is recognized; applies after mapping/normalization | No handling. XSLT text with requested CRLF retains LF in the tested capture | | [csv-separator](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#CSV_SEPARATOR) | Single separator character for CSV fields | No handling; CSV method boundary tested separately | | [csv-quote-character](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#CSV_QUOTE-CHARACTER) | CSV quoting control | No handling; cannot infer support from ignored JSON/text options | | [csv-header](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#CSV_HEADER) | Boolean controls writing the header from the supplied CSV structure | No handling; neither method path provides verified CSV output | XSLT text tolerance probes for canonical/layout/CSV keys deliberately test acceptance only. They do not show those parameters working in applicable methods. XML canonical and newline-bearing text probes provide stronger observed boundaries. Canonicalization entails more than sorting attributes; the examples are counterexamples, not a substitute implementation. ## 9. Participants The invoice batch is a JSON object with an invoices array. Each record carries ID, currency, a precomputed numeric total and a URI. The JSON serializer escapes data; string-join supplies the record separator. The manifest records exact outputs/errors and compatibility metadata. ## 10. Collaborations The portable expression parses the complete batch, selects its invoice members, serializes each separately with method=json and joins them using codepoints-to-string(10). Empty selection yields an empty string. Reordering invoices changes line order while retaining values. There is no terminal newline in this example; add one explicitly if the receiver requires it. ## 11. Consequences The portable output is valid JSON Lines with escaped URI solidi and exactly two lines for the main input. An escaped solidus decodes to the same URI. Exact map-key order is observed fixture output, not a general stable-order or canonicalization guarantee. fn CSV fallback and XSLT JSON sequence-as-array are separate existing behavior; this slice records them without engine changes. ## 12. Implementation Source evidence at the reviewed revision: [XdmSerializer.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Functions/XdmSerializer.cs), `ApplyParameter` ignores unrecognized map keys, and `Serialize` routes methods other than json/adaptive through XML-family serialization. Its JSON path retains its default escaping independently of the ignored new key. [OutputProperties.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.Xslt/Stylesheet/OutputProperties.cs) stores and parses EscapeSolidus but does not store the other additions. [ResultTreeSerializer.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.Xslt/Runtime/ResultTreeSerializer.cs) forwards that flag to [XdmJsonSerializer.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Json/XdmJsonSerializer.cs), whose sequence path can serialize multiple items as an array. Named existing evidence: `Capture_MethodFidelity_XmlHtmlTextJson` in [XsltCaptureTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/Capture/XsltCaptureTests.cs), and `Output_Text_Method_Serializes_Only_Text` in [StylesheetTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/StylesheetTests.cs). Those tests establish ordinary paths, not the nine additions. The catalog adds 52 named cases without changing engine/API/harness or promoting manual gates. ## 13. Sample Code Complete partner invoice input (totals are already calculated; no tax or currency conversion occurs here): ```json {"invoices":[{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1042"},{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1043"}]} ``` Portable XPath 3.1 JSON Lines export: ```xpath (: Complete invoice batch; serialize each record separately and join with LF. :) let $batch := parse-json('{"invoices":[{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1042"},{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1043"}]}') return string-join($batch?invoices?* ! serialize(., map{'method':'json'}), codepoints-to-string(10)) ``` Exact output, including one LF between the records and no terminal LF: ```text {"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1042"} {"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1043"} ``` Empty input: ```json {"invoices":[]} ``` The complete [empty expression](../examples/serialization-parameters/portable-json-lines-empty.xpath) returns the empty string. Reordered input: ```json {"invoices":[{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1043"},{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1042"}]} ``` The [complete reordered expression](../examples/serialization-parameters/portable-json-lines-reordered.xpath) returns: ```text {"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1043"} {"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1042"} ``` Observed fn:serialize solidus control boundary: ```xpath serialize(map{'uri':'https://partner.example/invoices/1042'}, map{'method':'json','escape-solidus':false()}) ``` Exact result (false is ignored): ```text {"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1042"} ``` Shared XML input for all XSLT probes: ```xml ``` Supported XSLT 3.0 solidus alternative: ```xml ``` Exact output: ```text "https://partner.example/invoices/1042" ``` Observed XSLT JSON Lines boundary: ```xml ``` Exact output is an array: ```text ["INV-1042","INV-1043"] ``` Observed XML canonical boundary: ```xml ``` Exact output: ```text ``` Observed requested CRLF text boundary: ```xml ``` Exact output contains LF, not CRLF: ```text INV-1042 INV-1043 ``` All fixtures below are linked in full. Outcomes shown as JSON string literals make empty strings, backslashes and newline characters unambiguous. sections.1:
**Serialization 4.0 parameter additions — Deferred, with a supported XSLT solidus control.** [REQ-118 tier-4 decision](../../REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md) remains; it must not imply that all serialization is missing. Bosak engine 1.1.2 reviewed against [revision 23218073](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/commit/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791).

Primary references: [Serialization 4.0 parameters](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#serparam), [Serialization 3.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/xslt-xquery-serialization-31/). Immutable review source: [serialization XML at e7ee4ab8](https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/blob/e7ee4ab8cb6c6c0f6f60014e2367f1a90909e69e/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/src/xslt-xquery-serialization.xml), section `serparam`. This is a review pin, not recovery of the missing historical adopted snapshot.
sections.2: Choose an invoice interchange format with predictable record boundaries, URI escaping and output layout. Record parameter-by-parameter behavior instead of equating accepted options with implemented serialization.
sections.3: Canonical output, JSON Lines, configurable indentation/line endings and CSV serialization controls. These are serialization parameters, distinct from XPath CSV parsing functions.
sections.4: The pinned source adds escape-solidus (issue 530/PR 534), json-lines (1471/1497), canonical (938/2259), layout controls (1234/2719) and CSV controls (2748/2794). This disposition covers those nine parameter additions, not every change to Serialization 4.0: GNodes, CSV data-model shapes, numeric/JSON rules, HTML defaults and other revisions require separate reviews.
sections.5: A partner imports one JSON invoice per physical line. Invoice identifiers, currency-labelled totals and URIs must survive serialization. A pretty JSON array cannot substitute for JSON Lines. Canonical output has a different purpose—stable representation for signing/digesting—and must use a verified canonicalization implementation.
sections.6:
| Path | Verified boundary |
|---|---|
| `fn:serialize` maps in XPath 3.1/4.0 | Nine new keys leave tested output unchanged; map-valued invalid options are tolerated |
| `fn:serialize` escape-solidus false | Still emits escaped solidus; tested default also escapes it |
| XSLT 3.0/4.0 output escape-solidus yes/no | Controls URI string escaping in the verified JSON outputs |
| `fn:serialize` json-lines true, two maps | `SERE0023` |
| XSLT json-lines yes, two strings | JSON array `["INV-1042","INV-1043"]`, not separate lines |
| `fn:serialize` method csv | Tested scalar sequence equals XML-family serialization; CSV is not established |
| XSLT method csv | `XTSE1570` |
| Explicit per-record serialization + LF joining | Portable invoice JSON Lines; empty and reordered cases verified |

Successful XPath 4.0 probes also assert the same default 3.1 outcome. XSLT error fixtures assert markers from compilation or capture; no detection-stage promise follows.
sections.7: Use existing XML/JSON/text serialization for ordinary exports. Build JSON Lines explicitly by serializing each record and joining the strings. Avoid these ignored options when a consumer requires canonical bytes, a custom layout or CSV. Do not assume that parser support for CSV delivers a CSV serializer.
sections.8:
The pinned nine-parameter boundary is:

| Parameter | Pinned draft contract | Bosak scope and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| [canonical](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_CANONICAL) | XML/XHTML Canonical XML 1.1; JSON canonicalization has its own rules | No handling in inspected option/property parsers. XML examples retain z-before-a attributes and an empty-element tag, so are not canonical XML |
| [json-lines](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#id-json-lines) | Serialize top-level items as successive JSON records separated by line endings | No option handling; XPath error and XSLT array behavior differ |
| [escape-solidus](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#JSON_ESCAPE-SOLIDUS) | Boolean controls escaping `/` as `\/` in JSON strings; adaptive has a separate parameter section | XSLT JSON yes/no verified; fn option ignored. Adaptive behavior not certified |
| [indent-unit](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_INDENT-UNIT) | Spaces or tabs (including literal `\t` escape), when indent is true | No handling. Current equality probes use default indent=false and do not prove an indented-layout mismatch; source inspection establishes missing control |
| [indent-attributes](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_INDENT-ATTRIBUTES) | Boolean refinement when indent=true; draft permits optional attribute line breaks | No handling. Absence of line breaks alone would not prove a draft violation |
| [line-ending](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#XML_LINE-ENDING) | LF, CR or CRLF; `\n`/`\r` escape notation is recognized; applies after mapping/normalization | No handling. XSLT text with requested CRLF retains LF in the tested capture |
| [csv-separator](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#CSV_SEPARATOR) | Single separator character for CSV fields | No handling; CSV method boundary tested separately |
| [csv-quote-character](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#CSV_QUOTE-CHARACTER) | CSV quoting control | No handling; cannot infer support from ignored JSON/text options |
| [csv-header](https://qt4cg.org/specifications/xslt-xquery-serialization-40/Overview.html#CSV_HEADER) | Boolean controls writing the header from the supplied CSV structure | No handling; neither method path provides verified CSV output |

XSLT text tolerance probes for canonical/layout/CSV keys deliberately test acceptance only. They do not show those parameters working in applicable methods. XML canonical and newline-bearing text probes provide stronger observed boundaries. Canonicalization entails more than sorting attributes; the examples are counterexamples, not a substitute implementation.
sections.9: The invoice batch is a JSON object with an invoices array. Each record carries ID, currency, a precomputed numeric total and a URI. The JSON serializer escapes data; string-join supplies the record separator. The manifest records exact outputs/errors and compatibility metadata.
sections.10: The portable expression parses the complete batch, selects its invoice members, serializes each separately with method=json and joins them using codepoints-to-string(10). Empty selection yields an empty string. Reordering invoices changes line order while retaining values. There is no terminal newline in this example; add one explicitly if the receiver requires it.
sections.11: The portable output is valid JSON Lines with escaped URI solidi and exactly two lines for the main input. An escaped solidus decodes to the same URI. Exact map-key order is observed fixture output, not a general stable-order or canonicalization guarantee. fn CSV fallback and XSLT JSON sequence-as-array are separate existing behavior; this slice records them without engine changes.
sections.12:
Source evidence at the reviewed revision: [XdmSerializer.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Functions/XdmSerializer.cs), `ApplyParameter` ignores unrecognized map keys, and `Serialize` routes methods other than json/adaptive through XML-family serialization. Its JSON path retains its default escaping independently of the ignored new key. [OutputProperties.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.Xslt/Stylesheet/OutputProperties.cs) stores and parses EscapeSolidus but does not store the other additions. [ResultTreeSerializer.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.Xslt/Runtime/ResultTreeSerializer.cs) forwards that flag to [XdmJsonSerializer.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Json/XdmJsonSerializer.cs), whose sequence path can serialize multiple items as an array.

Named existing evidence: `Capture_MethodFidelity_XmlHtmlTextJson` in [XsltCaptureTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/Capture/XsltCaptureTests.cs), and `Output_Text_Method_Serializes_Only_Text` in [StylesheetTests.cs](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/232180733358fc4239229267763854fda0fa2791/tests/Bosak.Xslt.Tests/StylesheetTests.cs). Those tests establish ordinary paths, not the nine additions. The catalog adds 52 named cases without changing engine/API/harness or promoting manual gates.
sections.13:
Complete partner invoice input (totals are already calculated; no tax or currency conversion occurs here):

```json
{"invoices":[{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1042"},{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1043"}]}
```

Portable XPath 3.1 JSON Lines export:

```xpath
(: Complete invoice batch; serialize each record separately and join with LF. :)
let $batch := parse-json('{"invoices":[{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1042"},{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1043"}]}')
return string-join($batch?invoices?* ! serialize(., map{'method':'json'}), codepoints-to-string(10))
```

Exact output, including one LF between the records and no terminal LF:

```text
{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1042"}
{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https:\/\/partner.example\/invoices\/1043"}
```

Empty input:

```json
{"invoices":[]}
```

The complete [empty expression](../examples/serialization-parameters/portable-json-lines-empty.xpath) returns the empty string. Reordered input:

```json
{"invoices":[{"id":"INV-1043","currency":"USD","total":12,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1043"},{"id":"INV-1042","currency":"EUR","total":30,"uri":"https://partner.example/invoices/1042"}]}
